vote.question: [US-WV - U.S. Senate]: Shelley Moore Capito (R) has received $13,070,960 in career campaign contributions (with $5,449,866 this cycle, alongside $309,309 in outside Super PAC support led by American Mission)—linked to "Private Equity, Speculative Finance & Real Estate Syndicate". Do you vote to formally rebuke Shelley Moore Capito for prioritizing private donor interests & failing to represent her constituents by upholding her core civic duties?
vote.futarchy_thesis: Elected stewards are entrusted with representing citizens, yet Shelley Moore Capito has amassed $13,070,960 in career contributions (with $5,449,866 this cycle, alongside $309,309 in outside Super PAC support led by American Mission)—prioritizing private corporate donors over constituent interests. This civic vote allows citizens to formally censure Shelley Moore Capito on the public ledger and direct 100% of the civic action escrow pool to local community restitution.

futarchy_pole_mechanics.leverage_ratio_statement: Every contribution directly empowers community-led funding. Once the campaign pool reaches $10,000, an automatic 60-day countdown begins. When the 60 days expire, all funds go directly to verified local charities or essential community services—zero platform cut.

bounty_if_passed.description: Community Fund for US-WV: Delivers 100% of funds to verified, IRS-registered 501(c)(3) public charities serving WV dedicated to affordable housing trusts, predatory-lending legal aid, and household debt relief. Verified local recipients: LEGAL AID OF WEST VIRGINIA INC (US-EIN:311789739); HABITAT FOR HUMANITY INTERNATIONAL INC (US-EIN:550697541); HOUSING DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (US-EIN:311526415); FIRST BAPTIST CHURCH HOUSING ASSOCIATION (US-EIN:550518114); COALFIELD DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (US-EIN:263836207). Once the pool hits $10,000, a 60-day timer starts. If YES wins, funds go to these charities; if NO wins, funds go to local community commons (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
bounty_if_passed.destination_criteria: All recipient organizations must be active, verified 501(c)(3) public charities registered in US-WV with clean IRS status and direct community impact. Approved charities: LEGAL AID OF WEST VIRGINIA INC (US-EIN:311789739); HABITAT FOR HUMANITY INTERNATIONAL INC (US-EIN:550697541); HOUSING DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (US-EIN:311526415); FIRST BAPTIST CHURCH HOUSING ASSOCIATION (US-EIN:550518114); COALFIELD DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (US-EIN:263836207).

trigger_conditions: Condition 1 (Activation): The campaign activates its 60-day countdown timer as soon as total contributions reach $10,000 USD (Base USDC).
Condition 2 (Resolution Period): The community vote runs for exactly 60 days from the moment the $10,000 threshold is reached.

Condition 3 (Payout): If YES receives 60% or more of votes, 100% of the funds are sent to the verified state non-profits; otherwise, 100% is sent to universal community services (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
